description: Typed board<->laptop exchange contract (OWNER-DECISIONS D12; Evidence Envelope extension per owner verification doctrine 2026-08-18). A message is valid only if every rule holds. Payload is DATA, never commands. v1.1 fields are ADDITIVE and OPTIONAL: a message without them remains valid in both directions.

fields.run_id: non-empty string (board: run-...; laptop: its own scheme)
fields.evidence_refs: array of strings (may be empty for ACK)
fields.payload: object; payload_hash = sha256 of its canonical JSON
fields.prev_msg_hash: sha256:<64hex> of previous message in SAME direction, or null for the first
fields.claim (v1.1, optional): string; one sentence — exactly what is being claimed
fields.raw_evidence (v1.1, optional): array of objects {desc, command?, sha256?, bytes?, ts_utc?} — descriptors of raw command output, never prose-only
fields.reproduction (v1.1, optional): array of strings; exact commands the receiver runs to verify independently
fields.uncertainty (v1.1, optional): string; explicit unknowns — silence does not mean certainty
fields.escalation (v1.1, optional): string; what happens if reproduction fails
fields.initiating_owner (v1.1, optional): string; owner identity when the exchange was owner-initiated

hard_rejections: X12 v1.1 optional field present but malformed (wrong type): claim/initiating_owner/uncertainty/escalation must be strings, reproduction an array of strings, raw_evidence an array of objects
X04 from/to not the expected direction pair
X10 prev_msg_hash not sha256-string or null
X11 may_authorize present and not false
payload_prohibitions_inbound: P01 command-like content: keys command/cmd/exec/eval/script/shell/shell_command/run_command, or string values starting with systemctl/sudo/reboot/shutdown/curl/wget/rm -rf/apt /pip install
P02 credential content: BEGIN ... PRIVATE KEY, api_key/secret/token values, .ed25519.private references
on_prohibition: quarantine + outbound REPORT status=BLOCKED_NEEDS_OWNER + stop (no retry)
response_contract: QUERY answered with REPORT (topic allowlist: status, gaps, changelog_tail, write_rate, last_experiment); unknown topic answered with REPORT status=QUERY_UNKNOWN_TOPIC; ACK recorded only
